chemistry-killer-04.title: Ionic bond, covalent bond da oxidation-reduction
chemistry-killer-04.topic: Ionic bond, covalent bond da oxidation-reduction
chemistry-killer-04.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-04.material:
A 25 °C an ƙara v mL na $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ mai ƙarfin da ba a sani ba zuwa 50 mL na $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M kuma aka auna mafi girman zafin gauraye. Zafin duka maganin biyu kafin haɗawa shi ne 20.0 °C.
Girman HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Mafi girman zafi bayan haɗawa (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Yawan gaurayen shi ne 1.0 g/mL, takamaiman zafi 4.0 J/(g·°C), girma jimillar girman maganin biyu ne kuma babu asarar zafi. Amsawar neutralization ita ce $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri ƙarfin HCl(aq) da neutralization heat (zafin da ake fitarwa lokacin samar da mole 1 na ruwa, kJ/mol)?

chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.prompt:
A 25 °C an ƙara v mL na $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ mai ƙarfin da ba a sani ba zuwa 50 mL na $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M kuma aka auna mafi girman zafin gauraye. Zafin duka maganin biyu kafin haɗawa shi ne 20.0 °C.
Girman HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Mafi girman zafi bayan haɗawa (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Yawan gaurayen shi ne 1.0 g/mL, takamaiman zafi 4.0 J/(g·°C), girma jimillar girman maganin biyu ne kuma babu asarar zafi. Amsawar neutralization ita ce $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri ƙarfin HCl(aq) da neutralization heat (zafin da ake fitarwa lokacin samar da mole 1 na ruwa, kJ/mol)?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Zafin yana hauhawa yayin da v ke ƙaruwa, ya kai mafi girma 29.0 °C a 25 mL sannan ya sauka saboda maganin da ba a neutralize ba yana ƙaruwa (jimillar maganin tana ƙaruwa). Don haka a 25 mL, H+ da OH- suna amsawa babu ƙari ko rashi.
Mataki na 2: NaOH 0.050 mol (1.0 M × 0.050 L) yana amsawa da HCl 1:1, don haka HCl 0.050 mol yana cikin 25 mL. Ƙarfi = 0.050 mol ÷ 0.025 L = 2.0 M.
Mataki na 3: Zafi Q = mcΔT = (50+25 mL × 1.0 g/mL) × 4.0 × 9.0 = 75 × 4.0 × 9.0 = 2700 J.
Mataki na 4: Neutralization heat = 2700 J ÷ 0.050 mol = 54000 J/mol = 54 kJ/mol.
Tabbatarwa: don v = 10 mL, duk H+ 0.020 mol ya amsa, ΔT = 0.020 × 54000 ÷ (60 × 4.0) = 4.5 → 24.5 °C. Don v = 40 mL, duk OH- 0.050 mol ya amsa, ΔT = 2700 ÷ (90 × 4.0) = 7.5 → 27.5 °C.
Amsa: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol (d). (Kuskure: 36 kJ/mol ƙima ce ta taron maganin 50 g, 108 kJ/mol ƙima ce ta mole na ruwa 0.025)

chemistry-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
